Your Denver Veterinarian
Patient and client care are at the forefront of our practice. We want you to have a warm and welcoming experience. We pride ourselves on the quality of care and level of communication that we offer. We stay in close contact with our owners in alignment with our high quality and modern medicine.
Denver Animal Hospital is proud to offer a vast array of services offered through fear-free handling. We emphasize comfortable techniques for our patients to ensure the smoothest visit possible.
We are here for you, we are here for your pet, and we are your neighborhood’s favorite vet. Please don’t hesitate to contact us today at
(303) 871-8719
to request your pet’s appointment!
New Clients Welcome!
At Denver Animal Hospital, you can expect state of the art medical care for your pet. We believe in nurturing the human-pet bond and creating a harmonious relationship between people and pets. You can expect to be greeted by a courteous receptionist, clean exam rooms, friendly doctors, and caring technicians. We appreciate the role we get to play in your pets’ health care.

What Our Clients Say
There aren’t enough words to express how much we love Denver Animal Hospital! We have been taking our cats to see Dr. Mich. She is thoughtful, kind, and patient. We feel completely comfortable with her and the other staff there. Both Dr. Mich and the receptionist are very communicative and are always happy to answer any questions that we have. We are so thankful for Dr. Mich and the staff at Denver Animal Hospital!
Hayley S.
If I could give more stars I would. I was dog sitting for my boyfriend and his two dogs got into the pantry and ate a bag of semisweet chocolate chips (which is dark chocolate). Boyfriend was on an airplane and asleep during this time so I had to act on my own. Quickly reading on the internet how deadly this is for small breeds I called the Denver Animal Hospital.  They told me I needed to bring them in right away. The whole staff took great care of the boys (and me). Obviously I am a mess. They explained the situation and what they needed to do to save their lives. I felt 100% confident in them to save them. They induced them, gave them charcoal to absorb as much toxins from their bloods as possible, gave them fluids and monitored their vitals.  After keeping them for about 7 hours I was able to bring them home and they were back to normal the following day.
Lauren V.
Amazing staff and docs! My cat was just diagnosed with diabetes and they went way out of their way to find me an insulin, food, etc in my price range and close to my home. They didn't HAVE to do that. Super sweet people. As the 20 year olds are saying, my experience was LIT. ;)
Kelly S.
My little buddy got snipped here because I had just moved from California to Colorado with him right around when he needed it, but I didn’t want him to have it right before a big move. The staff was so nice! Even every time I call they already know who I am and my cats’ names. I really love how personable and sweet everyone working here is. They even sent me photos of any concerns they had with my cat.
Sydney S.
